description:
You are a clinical research coordinator auditing VitalDB surgical recordings for data completeness. A VitalDB Case #6 .vital file is loaded in Vital Recorder.

Your task:
1. Review ALL vital sign tracks displayed in Vital Recorder for this case.
2. For each track, determine its actual recording duration by identifying where its data begins and ends (some tracks may not span the full case).
3. Identify which track has the SHORTEST total recording duration.
4. Create a report file at C:\Users\Docker\Documents\shortest_track_report.txt with EXACTLY this format:

Case: 6
Shortest Track: [DEVICE/PARAMETER_NAME]
Duration (minutes): [NUMBER]
Total Case Duration (minutes): [NUMBER]
Coverage Percentage: [NUMBER]%

Where:
- [DEVICE/PARAMETER_NAME] is the full track name (e.g., Solar8000/ART_MBP)
- Duration (minutes) is that track's recording duration rounded to the nearest whole minute
- Total Case Duration is the full recording length rounded to the nearest whole minute
- Coverage Percentage is (Duration / Total Case Duration * 100) rounded to the nearest integer

Note: The track name includes both the device name and parameter name separated by a slash.
